system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 12 hours, 20 Spell Uses. Lasts: 15 minutes. The target briefly enters one of Ninki's afterlifes. Any movement there is reflected on return to the real world, hypothetically escaping any confines. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
